prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production game worker sprite, not a UI screen.
Using the supplied Mission Frontier images as character-identity references, create an isolated full-body version of their friendly round-headed ceramic-white mechanical worker. First image supplies world style; second supplies the worker identity. Preserve the compact substantial proportions, white/off-white segmented rounded head, glossy very dark face panel with two tiny cyan-blue eyes, round dark ear joints, white torso and limb shells over charcoal mechanical joints, broad useful mechanical feet and subtle surface wear. No logos.
Pose: stationary parked neutral standing, both feet planted, arms relaxed at sides, head and torso facing screen lower right (southeast), three-quarter view with the robot's left side visible. Both eyes visible, far eye foreshortened. Camera fixed orthographic game view looking downward about 30 degrees, compatible with a 2:1 isometric ground projection. No tool, console or other object.
Lighting: restrained warm daylight from upper left with neutral fill; no environmental color spill. Crisp high-quality softly realistic rendered game art, same material world as reference, not cartoon, not voxel, not low-poly.
Composition: square image. Entire character from head to feet, no cropping, centered on a clean perfectly uniform saturated green #00FF00 background that will be removed. No cast shadow, no ground, no pedestal, no horizon, no vignette. Keep transparent-looking gaps between arms and torso and between legs as the same flat green. Robot only; no UI, text, numbers, status effects, selection ring, scenery, tool, extra limbs or characters. Height about 80% of canvas with generous margins. The background must not illuminate or tint the white robot.

Post-resize green spill clamp; zero RGB under alpha=0
